title: Devin Husseins executor
script:
-- Devin Husseins Executor Full Script Final
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DevinHusseinsExecutor"
gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0,555,0,309)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.2,25,0.0,3)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true
Main.Parent = gui

local UICorner0 = Instance.new("UICorner", Main)
UICorner0.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

-- Executor Page
local Main1 = Instance.new("Frame", Main)
Main1.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,27,0.8,2)
Main1.Position = UDim2.new(0.0,9,0.1,14)
Main1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
Main1.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
local UICornerMa = Instance.new("UICorner", Main1)
UICornerMa.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

-- Title فوق زر Execute
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main1)
title.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,25)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0,9,0,0) -- فوق زر Execute
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) -- أبيض
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,0) -- أصفر
title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
title.TextSize = 16
title.Text = "Devin Husseins Executor"

-- TextBox
local TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox", Main1)
TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.7,0,0.9,10)
TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.0,9,0.0,30)
TextBox.Text = " ضع سكربت "
TextBox.MultiLine = true
TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
TextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)

-- Execute Button
local exe = Instance.new("TextButton", Main1)
exe.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,19,0.2,0)
exe.Position = UDim2.new(0.7,17,0.0,4+25) -- تحت العنوان مباشرة
exe.Text = "Execute"
exe.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
exe.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
local UICornerexe = Instance.new("UICorner", exe)
UICornerexe.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

-- Clear Button
local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Main1)
clearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,19,0.2,0)
clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7,17,0.2,76)
clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
clearBtn.Text = "Clear"
clearBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
local UICornerClear = Instance.new("UICorner", clearBtn)
UICornerClear.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)
clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    TextBox.Text = ""
end)

-- Switch Buttons
local clea = Instance.new("TextButton", Main1)
clea.Size = exe.Size
clea.Position = UDim2.new(0.7,17,0.1,40)
clea.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
clea.Text = "Script Hub"
clea.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
local UICornercle = Instance.new("UICorner", clea)
UICornercle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

-- Script Hub Page
local Main2 = Instance.new("Frame", Main)
Main2.Size = Main1.Size
Main2.Position = Main1.Position
Main2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,0)
Main2.BackgroundTransparency = 0
Main2.Visible = false
local UICorner9 = Instance.new("UICorner", Main2)
UICorner9.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

-- Script Hub Title فوق الأزرار
local hubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main2)
hubTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,25)
hubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0,9,0,4)
hubTitle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
hubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,0)
hubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code
hubTitle.TextSize = 16
hubTitle.Text = "" -- فارغ، يمكنك وضع اسم إذا أحببت

-- Script Hub ScrollingFrame
local Scrsc = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", Main2)
Scrsc.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,-18,0.75,0)
Scrsc.Position = UDim2.new(0,9,0,35)
Scrsc.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Scrsc.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,300)
local Ui1 = Instance.new("UICorner", Scrsc)
Ui1.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,5)

-- Script Hub Buttons
local scripts = {
    {"SimpleSpy V3","https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-SimpleSpy-V3-13078"},
    {"Sky Hub","https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Sky-Hub-18710"},
    {"c00lkidd","https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-c00lkidd-50239"},
    {"Wolvexder GUI","https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-WolvexderGUI-46204"},
    {"Backdoor lalol","https://rawscripts.net/raw/GAME-Backdoor-lalol-24947"},
    {"FEARLESS GUI","https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-FEARLESS-GUI-49803"},
}

for i,v in ipairs(scripts) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", Scrsc)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,30)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,(i-1)*35)
    btn.Text = v[1]
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(v[2]))()
    end)
end

-- Switch Buttons Logic
clea.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Main1.Visible = false
    Main2.Visible = true
end)

local exe1 = Instance.new("TextButton", Main2)
exe1.Size = exe.Size
exe1.Position = exe.Position
exe1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
exe1.Text = "Executor"
exe1.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
local UICornere = Instance.new("UICorner", exe1)
UICornere.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)
exe1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Main1.Visible = true
    Main2.Visible = false
end)

-- Execute logic: يدعم أي صيغة require مباشرة
exe.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = TextBox.Text
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(code)()
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("خطأ في تنفيذ الكود: "..tostring(err))
    end
end)
